name: Sakusei Byoutou ~Jaaku naru Otsubone Nurse ga Hisomu Byouin de Choukyou Seikatsu~
original_name: 搾精病棟 ～邪悪なるお局ナースが潜む病院で調教生活～
source:
Yamada falls into the clutches of the “OG Three,” a triple threat of veteran nurses!

■Who are these sinister veterans who even nurses said to have the worst personalities fear?
“Begrudging Nurse” Tachibana, “Insidious Nurse” Kurokawa, “Violent Nurse” Yamaguchi, and “Demotivational Nurse” Hiramatsu.
Just like the rumors said, this hospital’s got nothing but nurses with the worst personalities.

But I had no idea there could be anybody worse than them!
They’re not just nasty… They’re pure evil.

That’s what Yamada would say about these seasoned nurses.
Some are obsessive, some wicked, and others unpredictable.
They're the absolute worst—and that's what makes them the best!

■A Story That’s Gaining Speed!
Man, all I did was break some bones and get hospitalized.
And yet everyone treats me like the scum of the earth!
Plus, recently things here have been feeling off.
Like there’s a dark cloud hanging over you no matter where you go…

The basic gameplay loop is that these awful nurses give main character Yamada a hard time, over and over again.
But they're very creative, so it never gets stale—and this time, the story that’s been waiting in the wings is finally taking center stage.

◆◇The Story◇◆

One day, I broke both of my hands and ended up in the hospital.
The truth is that I have a mysterious illness where if I don’t bust a nut every three hours, my balls will start to hurt.
And since I can’t use either of my hands, I had to have the nurses at the hospital jerk me off.

Sweet, gentle nurses, doing this and that for me… That’s what I imagined would happen.

But apparently everyone that lives around here knows that this hospital has nothing but nurses with the worst personalities!

translation:
山田落入了由资深护士组成的三重威胁“OG三人组”的魔爪！

■这些连护士都害怕的险恶退伍军人是谁？
“嫉妒护士”立花、“阴险护士”黑川、“暴力护士”山口、“消极护士”平松。
正如传闻所说，这家医院除了性格最差的护士之外什么都没有。

但我没想到还有比他们更糟糕的人！
他们不只是令人讨厌……他们是纯粹的邪恶。

这就是山田对这些经验丰富的护士的评价。
有些人是执着的，有些人是邪恶的，还有一些人是不可预测的。
他们绝对是最差的——但这正是他们成为最好的！

■故事正在加速！
伙计，我所做的只是摔断了一些骨头并住院了。
可所有人却把我当成地球上的败类！
另外，最近这里的事情让人感觉不太对劲。
就像无论你走到哪里，都有一片乌云笼罩着你……

基本的游戏循环是这些可怕的护士一次又一次地给主角山田带来困难。
但他们非常有创意，所以永远不会过时——这一次，一直在等待的故事终于登上了舞台的中心。

◆◇故事情节◇◆

有一天，我双手骨折，住进了医院。
事实上，我患有一种神秘的疾病，如果我不每三个小时吃一颗坚果，我的睾丸就会开始疼痛。
由于我的双手都不能使用，我不得不让医院的护士给我手淫。

可爱、温柔的护士们，为我做这做那……这就是我想象中会发生的事情。

但显然住在这附近的人都知道，这家医院除了性格最差的护士之外什么都没有！
